card.name: Inside hepatitis antiviral drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through hepatitis B and C antiviral drug names, on the syllable before the final -ir, such as sofosb-uv-ir, entec-av-ir and adef-ov-ir. It also fires on a few hepatitis terms such as surface and genotype numbers.

modes.label: Inside -vir drug names
modes.description: The middle syllable of nucleoside antiviral names just before the ending -ir.

modes.label: Hepatitis B/C terms
modes.description: Words in hepatitis virus descriptions, such as surface antigen or genotype numbers.
modes.example: chronic hepatitis B carriers (i.e.,<< surface>> antigen positive)

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of names of hepatitis antiviral drugs like sofosbuvir and entecavir.
